node.title: Re: Help requested to find the cause of an "uninitialized value" message
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Although not a direct answer to your question, I feel compelled to point out that [doc://Data::Dumper] is a debugging aid and not a data serialization tool. You may want to look at [doc://Storable], [doc://JSON::PP] (both core modules, there is also e.g. [mod://Cpanel::JSON::XS]), or any of the other serialization formats like YAML.

Having said that, I actually did write [mod://Data::Undump::PPI] to parse a subset of [doc://Data::Dumper] output. I would still recommend one of the above modules though.
